slides.body: No yoga guarantees wealth, and no planet predicts a market. This is behavioural awareness, not financial advice or a stock pick.
The Sun (Surya) stands for status and identity. As a bias it can mean putting too much into one prestigious name, role or asset, and being slow to admit a mistake.
The 2nd house is what you keep, and the 11th is what you gain. Read how the Sun relates to them with the whole chart. One placement proves nothing.

points: Cap any single position at a set share
Write exit conditions before you commit
Ask: would I buy this if nobody knew I owned it?
Consult a licensed advisor for real decisions

slides.body: Free Sun Placement Check: see how you handle status and risk.
